license_note: Meta publishes the model weights under the custom Llama 3.2 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a large-platform commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. The multimodal grant also excludes organizations established in the European Union, so public weights do not make this an open-source distribution.

license_evidence.scope: Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct weights, tokenizer, model code, and related Llama materials
Acceptable-use and multimodal regional restrictions incorporated into the Llama 3.2 Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct release. The 11B base model, 90B variants, quantizations, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Meta publishes both Transformers-compatible and original checkpoint artifacts
The official model card documents several self-operated runtimes and hosted deployment paths
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated and the custom license carries use, attribution, scale, and multimodal regional restrictions
Runtime and hosted-provider coverage can change independently of this fixed model release

evidence.label: Official model card, checkpoints, and deployment guidance
